items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Buddy Clark did some and Warne Marsh did some

ctx.x: I’d love it. Because I know what you’re saying because all those lower harmonies and stuff, and when they write the arrangements they’re not necessarily taking into account —

Med does. Med does all the writing. Well he did, Buddy Clark did some and Warne Marsh did some. Med never writes a repeated note, and for some reason he doesn’t use too many scales. I don’t know why he doesn’t do that because they’re usually kind of easy to voice and to play on. Or diminished chords. But even with that, I mean in other words he’ll cross voice, rather than repeat a note. But they’re still hard, they’re really hard.
How much time would you have to get that ready?
